info.title: FUNCTION-DocTest-List Utility Billing Disputes-v3-spec
info.description: The Utility Billing Disputes Retrieval API enables users to access a list of disputes related to utility billing. This endpoint allows organizations to efficiently track and manage customer grievances regarding their utility charges. Typical consumers of this API include customer service representatives and billing administrators who need to review and resolve disputes. By providing real-time access to billing disputes, the API helps improve customer satisfaction and streamline dispute resolution processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch details about a specific billing dispute. Ensure to provide the necessary query parameters to retrieve the correct information.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving billing dispute details. The request must contain all necessary information for processing the dispute query.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the billing dispute information.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesRequest.description: This schema represents a string-based request body for the billing dispute operations' GET request.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Reference number associated with the billing dispute.

resultId.description: Unique identifier for the result of the operation.

state.description: Current state of the billing dispute.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional details about the operation.

audit.description: Audit information related to the billing dispute.

ListUtilityBillingDisputesResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET operation related to billing disputes.

createdBy.description: Identifier for the user or system that created the audit record.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the audit record was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the audit action was performed automatically.
